title: Nothing is "on or off the table" regarding franchise tag for Trey Hendrickson

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Nothing is "on or off the table" regarding franchise tag for Trey Hendrickson
sources.description: Defensive end Trey Hendrickson was looking for a long-term deal with the Bengals for the last couple of years, but never got the contract he desired before playing out the final year of his current pact in 2025.
